caption: The drawing features two small, identical objects centered on a plain, light beige background. Each object is a round, intricately detailed earring with an ornate filigree pattern depicted in a golden-brown hue. The earrings have thin, curved hooks at the top, indicating their function as ear ornaments, and a small, spherical bead-like detail positioned near where the hook attaches to the rounded body. The objects are displayed side by side with a small space between them. The artist's name, "V. Van Voris," is written in small black text in the bottom right corner of the artwork. There is a faint rectangular border around the objects, slightly visible on the drawing.
title: Earrings
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
